sentences.text: This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual  /Physical Mode).

2. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioners and learned Addl. Standing Counsel for the State.
Perused the records.
3.

This is an application under Section 438, Cr.P.C. filed by the Petitioners for anticipatory bail,
involving offence punishable under Sections.376 (2)(n),294,323,354,379,506 and 34 of Indian Penal Code r/w Section 3(l)(r)(s) and 3 (2) (va), of S.C. & S.T. (P.O.A.) Act r/w Section-6 of POCSO Act in C.T. Case No. 137 of 2024 of the Court of learned Addl. District and Sessions Judge-Cum-Special Judge, under (POCSO) Act, Cuttack arising out of Baramba P.S. Case No.186 of 2024.
4. It is stated by the learned counsel for the petitioners that the present petitioners are the elder brother and mother of the principal accused namely Titan Nayak.
He further contended that so far allegation under Section 376 is concerned, the same is not made out against the present petitioners.
The only allegation against the present petitioners is that they ill-treated the informant when she approached the family members of the principal accused namely Titan Nayak.

5. Considering such submissions, the petitioners are directed to surrender before the learned Addl.
District and Sessions Judge-Cum- Special Judge, under (POCSO) Act, Cuttack, in the aforesaid case within four weeks from today.
